name: Elam
overview: Elam is a male biblical figure identified as a son of Shem, according to Genesis 10:22. Beyond this direct lineage, Scripture does not provide additional details about his tribe or other personal notes. His mention situates him within the genealogy that traces the descendants of Shem.
namesAndTitles: The name Elam is a proper name meaning 'highland,' as noted in Genesis 10:22. This name does not appear to be given directly by God but reflects a geographic or descriptive characteristic associated with him.
familyAndRelationships: Elam is explicitly recorded in Scripture as a son of Shem. No other family relationships are documented beyond this connection in the biblical text.
scriptureSignificance: Elam's significance lies primarily in his role as a progenitor within the genealogical record of Shem's descendants. This positions him as part of the foundational lineage from which various peoples and nations arose, underscoring the biblical emphasis on tracing God's providential plan through family lines.
